integrity_note: All numerical claims are exact integer exhaustive finite-state conclusions supported by independently implemented update algorithms, a direct successor-neighbor coloring count, and a full graph-symmetry certificate. No independent external audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Exact finite census for the twelve-vertex icosahedral graph only; no claim for general polyhedra, asynchronous rules, thresholds other than one, or stochastic excitation. Period-three qualitative behavior is related to earlier maximum-cycle-density theory.
title: Icosahedral excitation: exact three-cycle, geometric-orbit, and six-step entrance census
